prereg.ability: Two full-forward operations (B34/H2 and B33 MLP) at same prequestion offset on fixed 2200 formal MC items, 140 reference only; 2pp paired exact simultaneous bounds.
prereg.formal: 256 independent backgrounds, 128 per heldout, both T for behavior; hash-select one T per background before any edit. Require >=.80 overall and every split/frame/answer cell >=.65. Report selected one T plus full pairs. Gap uses complete model first-token logits and acceptable start-token variants; correctness uses actual generated first word.
prereg.margin_gate: Report median gap compared to previous exposed revision and subset of correctly generated baseline with clean first-token gap in (0,8]. Subset needs n_required for 10pp to make a powered conditional claim. Predetermined, no dropping cases from primary n=256.
prereg.pilot: 32 new backgrounds x two T x four profiles, only this split is read for selection. Non-direct profile eligible if strict natural first-word accuracy >=.80 and minimum frame/answer accuracy >=.65. Maximize number with clean gap in (0,8] then lower median gap, then fixed profile order. If none eligible, use direct and report lack of calibrated challenge.
prereg.primary: At shared prequestion token B34/H2, true Head α=.5 and 1; replay only B35 K/V slot on clean cache, rescue same slot on edited cache, K-only, V-only, matched norm scrambled B35 K/V delta. Same segmented evaluation layout. Primary behavioral criterion >=10pp net loss with paired exact p<.05 and >=5pp more loss than matched control. Trace exact bitwise replay and rescue separately from generation effect.
prereg.secondary: B33 MLP whole-write removal, first 32 lockbox backgrounds fixed by order, trace B34 and B35 K/V individually and combined. B35/H25 local-only negative engineering check on first 8 pilot cases. Any continuous effects are descriptive at n32.
